channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Charles Oakley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Charles Oakley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cedric Ceballos on Buck Williams, Stephen Curry, Charles Oakley
item.description:
Cedric Ceballos:

“I think that's the difference in the play of the game, too. I got criticized about Stephen Curry not being able to do what he did in my era because you got Oakleys and Masons and Buck Williams that are making 100,000and you're making what you're making and you shoot a 50-footer. You get touched up in the locker room. You know what I'm saying? I know y'all have Magic on here a lot, he talk about that. People getting in the fights with each other and Oakley slapping the shit out of them and all that. They because the dollar amount. So if I'm making 60 to 80, shoot that shit, Steph. I don't give a fuck. I'm making 60 to 80. I don't have to lose teeth to make what those guys was making.”

Cedric Ceballos on Buck Williams, Stephen Curry, Charles Oakley, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Max Rose on James Dolan, Charles Oakley
item.description:
“Again, the guy is a snowflake. He kicks fans out of the arena. Look what he did to Oakley and Charles Oakley is a legend. I’m just a congressman. Nothing would surprise me. What I will tell you is I’m not going to let Jim Dolan bully me. I’ve got swamp creatures in D.C. coming after me. I’m not worried about this guy. Come at me, bro. Come at me. But you’re going to lose. Which is, by the way, something that he’s very much accustomed to. So I’m sure this won’t be cataclysmic for him; it’ll just be another loss in a long series of losses. He’s a loser. He’s got to shut up and sell the team.”

Max Rose on James Dolan, Charles Oakley, Oct 10, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Spike Lee on Charles Oakley
item.description:
Lee said, in part,

“I put my hands behind my back and said arrest me like my brother Charles Oakley.”

Spike Lee on Charles Oakley, Mar 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Charles Oakley
item.description:
Ian Begley:Frank Ntilikina on meeting Knicks great Charles Oakley at All-Star weekend:

“I’m really thankful for what he said to me. He said (you) have a bright future and keep working on your game.”

Frank Ntilikina on Charles Oakley, Feb 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: James Dolan on Charles Oakley
item.description:
In an interview on ESPN Radio two days after the incident, Dolan said,

“To me, Charles has got a problem. We've said it before; he's his own worst problem. People have to understand that. He has a problem with anger. He's both physically and verbally abusive. He may have a problem with alcohol.”

James Dolan on Charles Oakley, Feb 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Charles Oakley
item.description:
Jay King:Scott Brooks:

“I'm sore just thinking about (Charles) Oakley. Oakley had a no-layup rule in training camp.”

Scott Brooks on Charles Oakley, May 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Donald Sterling on James Dolan, Charles Oakley
item.description:
“Oakley compared me to Dolan? Isn’t that amazing. I feel bad about Oakley. I wish that he could understand that there are no hard feelings by Dolan towards him. Owners don’t have hard feelings towards the players,”

Donald Sterling on James Dolan, Charles Oakley, Feb 17, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Spike Lee on Charles Oakley
item.description:
Four days later, Lee showed up in a #34 Oakley jersey, courtesy of a skilled stitch artist.

“I went home (after Oakley was ejected), I got every jersey, game-worn, but I couldn't find an Oakley jersey,”

Spike Lee on Charles Oakley, Feb 12, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: James Dolan on Charles Oakley
item.description:
“I don't know how to explain it. Maybe he doesn't remember it. I think that Charles has got a problem. I've said this before ...he has a problem. People need to understand that. He has a problem with anger, he's both physically and verbally abusive, he may have a problem with alcohol, we don't know. But those behaviors, being physically and verbally abusive, those are personality problems.”

James Dolan on Charles Oakley, Feb 10, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jayson Williams on Charles Oakley
item.description:
“(If the Knicks meant Oakley had an) anger issue ... the anger issue is what made the Knicks what they were. ... It wasn't about no damn anger issue when he was on the basketball court(playing for the Knicks). This made it look like the man was intoxicated. ... Charles Oakley buys a ticket to a Knicks game, and what is wrong with that? He is paying his $300 to watch the Knicks play.”

Jayson Williams on Charles Oakley, Feb 10, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jayson Williams on Charles Oakley
item.description:
“(If the Knicks meant Oakley had an) anger issue ... the anger issue is what made the Knicks what they were.... It wasn’t about no damn anger issue when he was on the basketball court (playing for the Knicks). This made it look like the man was intoxicated. ... Charles Oakley buys a ticket to a Knicks game, and what is wrong with that? He is paying his $300 to watch the Knicks play. That statement was meant to hurt Oak. That was hateful. ... (Dolan) meant to hurt Oak.”

Jayson Williams on Charles Oakley, Feb 9, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Charles Oakley
item.description:
Charles Barkley:

“Yeah I think so. First of all I want to give Kenny [Smith]…Kenny is wrong. We won 5 Emmy’s. [Host: Charles Oakley said you guys are a bunch of clowns. He says you are a fraud. What does that even mean?] I don’t even know what that means either. First of all I don’t take it personally. My job is to give my opinion. I don’t think everybody is going to like us, but listen I am going to do my thing. I am going to be honest and straightforward, but I don’t go crazy if people don’t like me. I don’t like him [Charles Oakley] going after Kenny and Ernie [Johnson] because they are both great, but if he don’t like the show I am not going to sweat it.”

Charles Barkley on Charles Oakley, Feb 27, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.
